title: MarkdownEditor
subtitle: Desktop Markdown editor
description: A Java desktop Markdown editor with live HTML preview, file-tree management, undo and redo, GFM tables, PDF export, and a bundled Windows installer.

title: BurmeseNLP
subtitle: Open-source Myanmar NLP toolkit
description: A dependency-light Python library for rule-based Myanmar language processing, including normalization, segmentation, POS tagging, phrase chunking, gazetteer NER, clause parsing, and corpus export.

title: Burmese POS Workbench
subtitle: XLM-R Myanmar POS tagging
description: A local Python and Streamlit workbench for word-level Myanmar part-of-speech tagging, powered by an XLM-R token classifier trained on myPOS data and high-confidence pseudo-labeled text.

title: Krypto
subtitle: Secure desktop file encryption
description: A JavaFX desktop application for AES-256 and ChaCha20 file encryption and decryption, with drag-and-drop input, password strength feedback, searchable history, CSV export, and configurable settings.

title: GEDSim
subtitle: GED-style practice platform
description: An AI-powered GED practice platform with automated question generation, practice tests, and mock examinations.

title: MeetToTalk
subtitle: Meetup discovery and sharing
description: A lightweight event platform for discovering nearby meetups, sharing them with one link, and organizing community events, coffee chats, and spontaneous hangouts.

title: NGM
subtitle: Education-focused website
description: An education-focused website for programs, resources, and learning initiatives.

title: Service Management System
subtitle: Full-stack service management
description: A service management platform for handling customer requests, tracking service tickets, and monitoring status across the workflow.

title: EchoPost
subtitle: Blogging platform
description: A blogging platform where users can create accounts, post blogs, comment on others' posts, and like blogs. Developed using React for the front-end and Laravel for the back-end with InertiaJS.

title: LMS
subtitle: Learning Management System
description: A Learning Management System with a React frontend and Java backend, providing dashboards and workflows for students and teachers.

title: Customer Churn Prediction
subtitle: ML-based churn risk dashboard
description: Developed a web application that predicts customer churn probability based on uploaded datasets. Implemented a machine learning model using Python and Scikit-learn, with a React-based frontend for data upload and result visualization.

title: ERP System
subtitle: Desktop ERP application
description: Developed as a team project at Host Myanmar Institute. Contributed as a Full-Stack Developer, working on the POS module, payment module, and unit exchange module. Built the application using Java SE and JavaFX for the user interface, with MySQL as the database.

title: DevAsk
subtitle: Q&A platform for developers
description: A Q&A platform inspired by StackOverflow, designed for developers to ask coding-related questions and provide answers.

title: Trash Trade
subtitle: Computer-vision trash trading
description: A project aimed at reducing global trash by using computer vision to detect trash types. Users can trade trash for points, which can then be exchanged for gifts.
